about: What the buildings of each neighbourhood along lines 64, 280 and tram 12 are, for tools/build_world.py. Polygons: neighbourhoods.geojson (Overture divisions, OSM-derived, ODbL). 'mix' = share of multi-storey residential buildings by type when OSM says nothing; footprint shape then decides building by building (long 10-13 m deep slabs and square towers read as panel blocks, irregular deep plans as new buildings). 'floors' = storeys for buildings without a height: [[max footprint m2, min, max], ...]; 'main' adds storeys on the boulevards. 'houses' = mix for detached houses. Types: panel (large-panel blocks 1965-1990: Bs-69 slabs, EPK towers), brick (socialist brick / monolithic blocks 1950-1980), stalinist (1948-1958), interwar (1920-1944 'кооперации': plaster, bay windows, cornices, tiled roofs), modern (1995-2025 residential: render with cladding accents, large windows, glass balconies, setback top floors), villa (post-1990 detached house: render, stone, large windows, flat or low roof), house (older detached house, tiled roof), office (modern office).

кв. Кръстова вада.note: Former villa zone on Cherni vrah below Vitosha, built up since the 2000s and still being built: complexes of new residential buildings (6-8 storeys typical, taller on Cherni vrah), closed complexes with gardens, boutique buildings, some remaining older houses. Capital.bg: 'a new residential district that is being concreted actively and chaotically'; The Green District alone has 21 buildings on 50 dka (2024).

кв. Манастирски ливади.note: Mostly built 2005-2025: closed complexes of 4-8 storey buildings with underground garages (EIGHT: four 6-storey buildings; Mona 1-4, Alpha/Beta/Gamma, Elizium ex Winslow Gardens), office buildings along bul. Bulgaria, some older houses in the west part.

ж.к. Манастирски ливади - Б.note: Low-rise new residential (OSM: 4 storeys) near the ring road.

Промишлена зона Хладилника.note: Former industrial zone (the cold store 'Хладилника', bread factory) turned into offices, the Paradise Center mall and new residential buildings since the 2000s; industrial halls remain.

ж.к. Лозенец.note: Interwar and 1950s-70s brick buildings in the north, dense new residential (2000s-2020s, often 6-10 storeys) towards the south and Cherni vrah.

ж.к. Хиподрума.note: 1970s-80s large-panel and EPK blocks (OSM up to 17 storeys) with new infill buildings.

ж.к. Стрелбище.note: 1970s-80s panel blocks (EPK, Bs-69; listings give 'ЕПК' as the construction type) with some new buildings.

ж.к. Гоце Делчев.note: 1960s-70s brick and panel blocks along bul. Gotse Delchev, new infill.

ж.к. Борово.note: 1970s-80s panel blocks, new residential along bul. Bulgaria.

ж.к. Белите брези.note: 1960s-70s blocks, EPK towers up to 15 storeys (OSM median 11), new infill.

ж.к. Красно село.note: 1950s-60s brick blocks and later panel blocks.

ж.к. Иван Вазов.note: Interwar and 1950s brick residential, new infill.

кв. Драгалевци.note: Former village at the foot of Vitosha: mostly luxury villas, single-family houses and small residential complexes; low-rise apartment buildings (2-5 storeys, often with pitched roofs); the old village centre with traditional houses. OSM median 2 storeys, max 5.

кв. Бояна.note: Villa quarter below Vitosha: modern villas and houses, gated low-rise residential complexes (2-5 storeys), the old village core with traditional houses, the Boyana church. OSM median 3 storeys, max 5.

Център.note: Oborishte/Sredets around the University and the National Library: interwar apartment buildings ('кооперации', 4-6 storeys, plastered, bay windows, cornices, often tiled roofs), pre-1920 neoclassical houses, Stalinist and socialist-era infill, some new buildings. OSM median 5 storeys.

ж.к. Яворов.note: 1950s-60s brick blocks (some Stalinist), interwar on the edge of the centre, new infill.

ж.к. Гео Милев.note: 1950s-70s brick and panel blocks, new buildings along Tsarigradsko shose.

ж.к. Изток.note: 1960s brick blocks and later panel blocks, the Iztok park edge; new buildings along the boulevards.

НПЗ Дианабад.note: Former industrial zone along G. M. Dimitrov / Tsarigradsko: offices, hospitals, new residential.

ж.к. Младост 1.note: 1970s panel blocks (Mladost was built from 1966), new infill.

ж.к. Дървеница.note: 1970s-80s panel blocks (OSM up to 16 storeys), new residential.

ж.к. Студентски град.note: About 60 student-hostel blocks raised from the 1960s to the 1990s (prefabricated and brick), and since the 2000s many new residential, office and commercial buildings, clubs and cafes.

кв. Илиянци.note: Former village north of the railway ring: one- to three-storey houses on small plots, a few 1970s-80s brick blocks and new low-rise apartment buildings near the tram terminus (zone Смф2: low-rise, density up to 40 %).

Промишлена зона Илиянци.note: Industrial and wholesale zone along Илиянско шосе / бул. Рожен: warehouse halls, the Стоков базар Илиянци market, factory sites (Софарма, Хюндай), office and showroom buildings of 2-5 storeys; OSM industrial / warehouse / retail classes take precedence.

Военна рампа.note: Industrial zone with logistics halls and new office buildings.

ж.к. Триъгълника-Надежда.note: 1970s-80s large-panel estate (Надежда): 8-16 storey slabs and towers, later ETICS insulation patchwork.

ж.к. Лев Толстой.note: 1960s-80s panel and brick blocks round бул. Рожен / Lev Tolstoy.

ж.к. Банишора.note: 1950s-70s brick apartment blocks and some panel blocks behind Опълченска / Мария Луиза, interwar houses and new infill.

ж.к. Фондови жилища.note: State housing-fund blocks of the 1960s-70s (brick and early panel), 6-10 storeys.

ж.к. Зона Б-18.note: 1970s-80s "zone B" redevelopment beside бул. Христо Ботев: brick and panel blocks, 7-12 storeys.

ж.к. Зона Б-5.note: 1970s-80s redevelopment between бул. Христо Ботев and бул. Константин Величков: brick and panel blocks.

ж.к. Сердика.note: South of the Central Station: 1950s Stalinist blocks along Мария Луиза, 1960s-80s brick and panel blocks, new infill.

sources: OSM/Overture building:levels per neighbourhood within 120 m of the routes (see NEIGHBOURHOODS.md)
